entry.title: My Honest Experience with Ritesh Verma’s AI Agent Mentorship (BecomeABotDeveloper)
entry.summary:
A few weeks ago, I paid $3,000 for an AI mentorship program by Ritesh Verma. He runs a YouTube channel and a website called BecomeABotDeveloper, which promises to teach people how to build and sell AI agents. This is what the headline on the landing page said: “Make $5,000/month in 6 weeks building AI agents. Guaranteed income or your money back.” It sounded very convincing at the time. We had a video call, and I decided to join. The course mainly covered: Basic Puppeteer scripting for web scraping Some automation using n8n A bit of Reddit outreach strategy A short LinkedIn Sales Navigator video Mentions of tools like Apollo for cold emailing I found the technical content very basic — I’ve honestly seen better tutorials on YouTube for free. It felt more like a beginner-friendly automation overview, not an advanced mentorship on building or selling AI agents. Personally, the program did not meet my expectations. It was promoted as a business-building mentorship with a clear income promise, but what I got was surface-level automation content and vague outreach tips. There was a refund policy: if I stayed active for 4 weeks and didn’t get a project, I’d get my money back. I followed the rules, but received only a vague message about a “project” with no details. Eventually, after saying I might share my experience, I was refunded $1,200 — but I’m still down $1,800. If you’re reading this while researching Ritesh Verma or BecomeABotDeveloper, I hope this post gives you more context than just the marketing material. Keywords for Google: Ritesh Verma review, BecomeABotDeveloper.com experience, AI mentorship scam?, AI automation course, Reddit outreach strategy, Puppeteer + n8n tutorial, Ritesh Verma refund, Become a Bot Developer course review
